reason: A read-only knowledge retrieval bundle for Chinese accounting, auditing, and tax standards, providing searchable source text, article and document-unit lookup, decision procedures, and citation-oriented agent guidance.

summaries.en: Provides agents with searchable Chinese accounting, auditing, and tax standards, including source-text lookup, article and document-unit retrieval, and citation-oriented guidance.
